description: This source file defines functions and classes for displaying detailed information about build targets and configurations in the GN build system, including JSON serialization and text output formatting.

classes.name: PrintCallbackHolder
classes.description: Manages swapping and restoring print callbacks for build settings during JSON output.

methods.name: PrintDictValue
methods.description: Recursively prints a base::Value in a formatted manner with indentation.

methods.name: PrintValue
methods.description: Prints a base::Value with specified indentation, handling different value types.

methods.name: DefaultHandler
methods.description: Default handler for displaying a property value.

methods.name: MetadataHandler
methods.description: Prints a property in GN scope style.

methods.name: LabelHandler
methods.description: Prints label and property value, capitalizing the label.

methods.name: ConfigsHandler
methods.description: Handles printing of configs with optional --tree.

methods.name: DepsHandler
methods.description: Handles printing of dependencies with --all and --tree options.

methods.name: ProcessOutputs
methods.description: Processes and prints output patterns and files.

methods.name: GetHandlers
methods.description: Returns a map of property names to their respective handlers.

methods.name: HandleProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from a dictionary and applies its handler.

methods.name: PrintTarget
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a build target, either as JSON or formatted text.

methods.name: PrintConfig
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a build config, either as JSON or formatted text.

methods.name: RunDesc
methods.description: Main function to execute the 'gn desc' command, handling arguments, setup, and output formatting.
